answer.text: An online platform where investors can file and track complaints against SEBI-registered entities including mutual funds and their intermediaries
A credit scoring system for mutual fund investors similar to CIBIL
A performance scoring system that ranks mutual fund schemes
A training and certification platform for mutual fund distributors

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM Series V-A workbook (p91), SCORES is SEBI's web-based, centralised grievance redress system that allows investors to lodge complaints against SEBI-registered entities and to follow up and track their complaints online. AMC grievances must be redressed not later than 21 calendar days under the same workbook reference. The Trap: The word "SCORES" can mislead candidates into thinking it is a scoring or rating system. It is not a credit score, scheme ranking, or training platform — it is an investor grievance redress portal operated by SEBI. Note: The AMC's redressal timeline tested in the same context is 21 calendar days, not 30 days — pairing the SCORES definition with the correct AMC turnaround is the precise workbook position.
